import json, os, tempfile, time, contextlib, sys, hashlib, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

projects=[Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe"), Path("/Users/steventran/Sonary")]
results=[]

for project in projects:
    key=hashlib.sha256(str(project.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    runtime_pkg=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key/"runtime/do_again"
    if not runtime_pkg.is_dir():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing installed runtime for {project}")

    # Import this project's installed runtime copy under an isolated module name.
    mod_path=runtime_pkg/"service/liveness.py"
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(f"liveness_{key}", mod_path)
    liveness=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(liveness)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        root=Path(td)
        test_repo=root/"repo"; test_repo.mkdir()
        state=root/"state"; state.mkdir()
        control=root/"control"; control.mkdir()
        receipts=control/"automation/do_again/receipts"; receipts.mkdir(parents=True)

        receipt=receipts/"r1.json"
        receipt.write_text('{"request_id":"r1"}',encoding="utf-8")
        old=time.time()-3600
        os.utime(receipt,(old,old))
        (test_repo/"do-again.toml").write_text(
            "[do_again]\ncontinuous = true\nidle_seconds = 60\nrecovery_seconds = 60\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        target=Mock()
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"ensure_browser_running",return_value={"port":9223}))
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"project_record",return_value={"chat_url":"https://chatgpt.com/c/project"}))
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_find_chatgpt_target",return_value=target))
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_assistant_snapshot",return_value={"busy":False}))
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_context_limit_warning",return_value=""))
            stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"_page_contains",return_value=False))
            send=stack.enter_context(patch.object(liveness.browser,"send_message"))
            send.side_effect=TimeoutError("injected cross-project transport outcome unknown")

            try:
                liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
            except TimeoutError:
                pass
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"{project}: initial transport failure did not surface")

            first=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
            first_calls=send.call_count
            send.side_effect=None
            second=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
            second_calls=send.call_count

            row=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())
            row["idle_resume_at"]=time.time()-120
            (state/"liveness.json").write_text(json.dumps(row),encoding="utf-8")
            third=liveness.check_liveness(test_repo,control,state)
            third_calls=send.call_count
            final=json.loads((state/"liveness.json").read_text())

        if first.get("idle_resume_phase")!="uncertain":
            raise SystemExit(f"{project}: missing uncertain phase")
        if first_calls!=1 or second_calls!=1 or third_calls!=1:
            raise SystemExit(f"{project}: duplicate send detected {(first_calls,second_calls,third_calls)}")
        if second!="idle_delivery_uncertain":
            raise SystemExit(f"{project}: expected idle_delivery_uncertain, got {second}")
        if third!="stalled_idle_handoff":
            raise SystemExit(f"{project}: expected stalled_idle_handoff, got {third}")
        if "No receipt arrived" not in str(final.get("idle_resume_error","")):
            raise SystemExit(f"{project}: missing actionable stall reason")

        results.append({
            "project":str(project),
            "runtime_path":str(runtime_pkg),
            "first_state":first.get("state"),
            "second_state":second,
            "third_state":third,
            "send_calls":[first_calls,second_calls,third_calls],
            "marker":first.get("idle_resume_marker"),
        })

print(json.dumps(results,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("CROSS_PROJECT_INSTALLED_RUNTIME_FAULT_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
